note: The apple tree's missions (world/missions.gd, shown under the compass; TreeQuest runs them). They start the first time he comes into the tree grounds. A step is done when its event happens: gather:<item> (his pack), root_hall_in, torch_lit, knothole_ledge, ladder_found, bough_reached (where he is: TreeQuest), web_seen, line_cut, weaver_down, weaver_beaten (OrbWeaverLair). An event that finishes a later step skips ahead.

steps.text: Break sap off the tree's roots or at Sap Falls, for resin
hint: Old trees bleed sap. Once it's hard, it'll burn.
Resin on a stick... that's a torch.

steps.text: Go into Root Hall, between the roots on the tree's east side
hint: There's a gap between those two big roots. It goes right inside the tree.

steps.text: Light your torch in the dark
hint: I can't see a thing in here. The torch.

steps.text: Find the way up inside the trunk
hint: Air's coming down from somewhere up there.

steps.text: Find the silk ladder hanging on the tree's west side
hint: From up on the ledge I saw something hanging off a branch, round the far side.

steps.text: Climb it to the Old Bough
hint: It's a long way up. Better not look down.

steps.text: Look up: something lives over the bough
Cut a guy line holding the web down
hint: I can't reach it up there. But those lines hold the whole web down.

steps.text: Cut all three before it mends them
hint: It's quick on its web. I need to be quicker.

steps.text: Beat it on the bark, where it's clumsy
hint: Watch its back legs, and don't let it bite.
Golden silk. That's worth something to someone.
